worktree.rationale: Each task workspace has its own ordinary Git worktree and branch on local disk. Worktrees separate checkout files, while execution permissions and protected-path behavior depend on each agent/mode. The source explicitly notes scripts or unprompted edits can evade some guards; this is not established as a container/VM boundary.

parallel-runs.rationale: The product runs multiple task agents in parallel and can queue several tasks at once, respecting agent-plan limits. Several chats can share a workspace. The board/chat/sidebar and PR bar expose task progress, agent attention, CI failures and merge outcomes. The queue marks tasks that need the user.
